targets.query:
import "contrib/tomhollingworth/events"
import "influxdata/influxdb/monitor"

from(bucket: "LiviusStats")
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
   // |> range(start: -1d, stop: now())
    //  |> range(start: 2022-04-13T23:29:39Z, stop: 2022-04-14T15:42:30Z)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gasstat")
    // |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_stop", "_measurement"])
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> increase()
    |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "gasrate")
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, columns: ["gasrate"])
    |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "gascnt_delta")
    |> difference(columns: ["gascnt_delta"])
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.gascnt_delta > 1) //filter state changes
    |> reduce(
        fn: (r, accumulator) =>
            ({
                sumVH: ((float(v: r.gasrate < 0.1 and r.gasrate > 0.0795) + (float(v: r.gasrate > 0.1) /2.0))* float(v: r.gascnt_delta +1) *0.108)+ accumulator.sumVH,
                sumGH: ((float(v: r.gasrate <= 0.0795) + (float(v: r.gasrate > 0.1) /2.0))* float(v: r.gascnt_delta +1)* 0.108) + accumulator.sumGH,
            }),
        identity: {sumVH: 0.0, sumGH: 0.0},
    )
